zh.title: 出租房出售：租客通知、进屋规则和加州租客保护要点
zh.seo_title: 加州出租房出售：租客与税务要点｜陈靖
zh.description: 出售有租客的房子，要先弄清租约、Tenant Protection Act 的 Just Cause 规定和本地条例。本文说明租客通知、进屋看房规则、押金转移，以及预扣和折旧回收等卖方税务问题。
zh.lead: 卖出租房最大的不同，是房子里住着受法律保护的人。卖房本身不会让租约自动结束，要先查清楚适用哪条法律。

en.title: Selling a Rental Property in California: Tenants and Rules
en.seo_title: Selling a California Rental: Tenant Rules | Jing Chen
en.description: How to sell a tenant-occupied home in California: just cause rules, tenant notices, entry for showings, security deposits and common seller tax issues.
en.lead: A rental differs from other sales because someone with legal protections lives there. A sale does not by itself end a tenancy, so start by working out which rules apply.
